# Browser libraries

These copies are hosted with the site so the interactive pages do not depend on a third-party script CDN.

- D3 7.9.0 — https://d3js.org — Copyright 2010–2023 Mike Bostock. ISC license in `d3-LICENSE.txt`. Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js
- Lucide 1.8.0 — https://lucide.dev — License and attribution in `lucide-LICENSE.txt`. The bundled UMD distribution is used for the notebook/workbench icons.
- GSAP 3.15.0 — https://gsap.com — Copyright 2026 GreenSock. The distribution retains its license notice and is subject to https://gsap.com/standard-license. Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js
